subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram webhook responses do not identify durable acceptance

question: Which stable HTTP header name and value should define Telegram durable acceptance for external ingress controllers?
rationale: The implementation boundary and semantics are clear, but selecting a permanent externally consumed response contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Dedicated acceptance header
options.body: Add a documented Telegram-specific header with one stable value after durable new or duplicate acceptance only.

options.title: Structured success body
options.body: Replace the empty success response with a machine-readable body, creating a larger response-shape compatibility surface.

options.title: Keep status-only behavior
options.body: Retain the current empty 200 and leave controllers unable to distinguish durable acceptance from unrelated successful responses.

recommendation.title: Dedicated acceptance header
recommendation.body: Add a documented Telegram-specific header with one stable value after durable new or duplicate acceptance only.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to this frequent webhook-area contributor, making them the best available owner for selecting the public response contract.
